protocol.name: MPIB photometric convention recovery on fixed public-proxy development set
protocol.geometry: same PNG8 disparity / 255, no normalization; focus parsed from existing filenames and checked against metadata
protocol.output: clamp [0,1], round to PNG8; each frame independent
protocol.selection: Compare the full metric profile with the paper MPIB row, not Any-to-Bokeh's row and not maximum PSNR. Only two gamma candidates. Report every metric and both results. If evidence conflicts, leave selection unresolved; no post-hoc weighted score or intermediate gamma search.
limits: Closeness on replacement scenes cannot identify the author's unpublished adapter uniquely.
This set is reproduction development data, not a held-out fairness test.
Project 24-transition RM and public-code 2-transition RM must be labeled separately; the historical paper implementation is not fully known.
No paper by-K breakdown is available; by-K and qualitative checks are internal diagnostics, not paper-match thresholds.
Freezing before Ours does not eliminate selection bias. Transfer to other color domains requires declared applicability.

fvd.preprocessing: cdfvd video preprocess: short side 256 + center crop; byte conversion; public VideoMAE resize 224; [0,1]
fvd.adaptation: n_fake='full' prevents default 2048 repeated samples; PNG decoding replaces video decoding
fvd.temporal_note: public tubelet_size=2: 25 input frames yield 12 temporal tokens; final unmatched frame is unused
fvd.covariance: public FeatureStats population covariance / scipy sqrtm

protocol.scope: public metric kernels with documented PNG/count/scene-boundary adapters; not exact paper replication

selection.criterion: Smaller absolute deviation from the paper MPIB row in all six predeclared metrics; no weighted score needed. This is reproduction convention recovery, not maximum-score selection.
selection.limits: Does not identify the unpublished author adapter uniquely. Current development-set matching is not independent benchmark validation; different source/GT/metric conventions remain. Freeze before Ours does not remove selection bias.
selection.application: Current baseline sweep and subsequent MPIB runs retain gamma=2.2. New input/photometric domains need an explicit protocol; do not change according to Ours results.

official_demo_equivalence.comparison: official demo pre-JPEG float output rounded to PNG8 vs adapter PNG8

visual_review.observations: No gross frame/focus mismatch in 40 paired keyframes. Strong-blur occlusion reconstruction differs from known-layer GT (notably repro_000); source crop edges retained. No result-based parameter change.

timing.scope: Shared two-gamma inference with concurrent evaluation; not a standard efficiency benchmark

additional_visual_review.selection: Post-score diagnostics: gamma2.2 minimum PSNR, maximum FD, maximum RM respectively; no samples removed or parameters changed
additional_visual_review.observations: No obvious frame/focus mismatch in inspected keyframes. gamma2.2 is visibly brighter than sRGB GT in strong-blur mixed high-contrast areas (zebra repro_068 and background repro_193). Occlusion and source-crop artifacts retained. Not a full temporal-video audit.
